The case of the respondent No.1 (complainant) is that he filed a petition of complaint under Section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the Magistrate, 1st Class, Tangail against the petitioners herein for drawing up a proceeding against the petitioners from entering into dispossessing the respondent-informant from 6.40 acres of land alleging, inter-alia, that the respondent is the owner in possession of the land measuring 6.40 acres appertaining to 26 plots of C.S. Khatian No. 136 and R.O.R. Khatian Nos. 184, 162, 170, 81 and 82 of Mouza-Gajutia and .20 acres of land appertaining to Plot No. 57, R.O.R. khatian No. 51 of Mouza Dakaitmara under Police Station, Nagarpur, Tangail as specifically described in the schedule of the petition.
